title: Get help by video
intro: A video appointment lets you speak with a Harbor Help adviser from a phone, tablet or computer.
fact_title: What is the same for everyone
fact_body: A video appointment is not recorded. Harbor Help cannot see inside your device.
privacy_body: We will not ask for your password or bank details. You can ask a trusted adult to join if that helps.
action: Choose a time for a video appointment, or ask a trusted adult to help you book.
support: Call the support line if you need help with the service.
